workflows.description: Capture one selected item while reading as a source-backed record in a short fixed pass: one batched lookup of the item and its terms in every base, pending uses included; a decision by the conflict rules; a draft citing its lines verbatim, or an in-place edit of the recorded item; accept and index in one command; then link the pending uses it defines.

Extract draft records for the new knowledge of a bounded scope of one registered source guided by its document type, with one batched lookup and one write pass, settle the knowledge already recorded by the conflict rules, then check, generate the source's def/pending sheet for owner review and index in one command.
Look up the drafts ticked in a source sheet again in one batch under the conflict rules, accept exactly those rows and index in one command, then link the pending uses of the new concepts.

Search, resolve, follow links, browse, pack and read records across every registered base read-only, deliver source:lines with evidence quotes, classify candidate identity, and refresh the derived index only when results report lag.

Install with the retrieval extra, register bases, source globs, document types and the embedding model in the home, check records against their sources, build or restore the derived index, install the Obsidian plugin and link the agent runtimes.
